question: The public sector was the focus of the ________ and planned on bringing rapid industrialization in the country.

options.text: third five year plan in India
fifth five year plan in India
first five year plan in India
second five year plan in India

solution:
The correct answer is __**second five year plan in India.** __

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Second Five Year Plan:-

 
 
• The Second Five Year Plan in India was planned under the leadership of Jawaharlal Nehru for the period from 1956 to 1961.
 
• It was based on the P.C. Mahalanobis model built-in 1953.
 
• Its main emphasis was on the country's economic growth.
 
• This plan lagged below its 4.5 percent target growth rate and reached a 4.27 percent growth rate. 
 
• This plan was opposed by many experts, and India faced a payment crisis in 1957 as a result.
 
• The public sector was the focus of this five year plan and it planned on bringing rapid industrialization in the country.
